Results.ReviewText: I really like this grill.  It heats up very quickly and does a great job on the steaks I have cooked so far.  My only issue is with cleaning the grate.  Residue just doesn't want to come off.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a high-quality grill. I purchased this several weeks back to replace an earlier model just like it. I had the other model for about 10 years.
Results.Title: Perfect for RV camping.

Results.ReviewText: Still can’t get it working right, and zero help from Customer Support.
Results.Title: Ignighter

Results.ReviewText: This is the best portable grill on the market! I use this at least 3 times a week.  Perfect size for the 3 of us.
Results.Title: size

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic product. Really glad I ordered it. We are going to use it for camping in our pop-up
Results.Title: ♥️

Results.ReviewText: I love my little space saver grill. Just the perfect size for an older lady to handle. Thrilled with my purchase.
Results.Title: Perfect

Results.ReviewText: Perfect patio grill for a condo/townhouse. Weber is a great brand, food cooks great.
Results.Title: Weber q1200

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill!  We love it and only wish we had purchased it years ago!  Cooks evenly and cleans easily!  Good instructions and recipe suggestions!
Results.Title: Great grill review!

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. It's just the right size for me. I have been using it 3 times per week since I got it.
Results.Title: Perfect size and great quality

Results.ReviewText:
Good quality product that cooks great. Fits nicely in the storage compartment of our RV.
 Lives up to the Weber standard.
Results.Title: Weber Portable Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I gave it 5 stars because it is a Weber but I have one challenge.  It takes a lot of time getting up to operating temperature and drops very quickly when the top is opened.  I live in Michigan and cooking in the spring and fall with this will be a challenge.

Also, I wish with all of my might that Weber would take manufacturing back to the U S of A.  I love your grills, but you gotta make them here!
Results.Title: 5 Stars With A Reservation About Operating Temp

Results.ReviewText: Just the right size. Heats fast and even. I can fit 8 burgers on it. Easy to clean, maintain, and store.
Results.Title: Exactly what I needed.

Results.ReviewText:
It is just the right size for me and my wife to enjoy outdoor barbecuing without the larger barbecue using more gas and wasted space for storage.

We are very pleased with the resulting flavor and ability to use the out doors without heating up the kitchen and house.

The biggest reason we bought Weber is this is the only Barbecue made in the USA.
Results.Title: Weber is an outstanding value and Made in the USA

Results.ReviewText: Get the unit with the temp gauge.  I alway used to cook with lid open but truck to this one is keep lid closed.  Love how it’s compact but does job as well as the big type grills.  Need to make sure windy conditions don’t blow the flame.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 grill

Results.ReviewText: Good. Hard to regulate temp. Great for burgers.  Not for steaks.
Results.Title: Good Portable.

Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill I ever owned. I'm so glad I clicked on a random internet article about portable grills and which ones are the best, because this one was it.
Results.Title: The weekend can't come fast enough for me to grill

Results.ReviewText: A nice compact grill,easy to use,a little hard to clean the cooking grates though,pretty direct heat so it does heat quickly and some food has a tendency to stick during cooking.but overall I gave this grill a 4 for the quality products that weber makes
Results.Title: The Q 1200

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking your time to submit your feedback! We are very sorry to hear about your lid thermometer. We will be happy to look into your warranty options for that part. Our support team just reached out to you via email. As for the clean up process, we will make sure to pass your feedback to our design team!

Results.ReviewText:
The thermoter on the grill is not accurate, the grates are hard to clean. Concave shape makes it hard to clean up grease under the burner afterwards. Can't believe had to buy a seperate stand for the grill which was also expensive.
Positives are the  the grill is light, burner is consistent.
Results.Title: Hard to clean but efficient

Results.ReviewText: Well built, great features, good for backyard, camping, tailgating, etc. (small groups)
Results.Title: One happy camper!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the right size that my wife and I were looking for. It cooks everything well and just sips off of the 1lb propane tank it uses. The fold out tables are really convenient for plates and we bought a griddle plate for one side for when we want to do breakfast on it. Good job Weber, the Q1200 is a good grill!
Results.Title: Just what I was looking for

Results.ReviewText:
I'm not a grill master.  I've watched a little PBS showing great cooks and want to be able to go outside a make a few simple meals for the family.  I've used larger gas grills in the same price range but I chose to go with the small Weber Q because it would easier to store away from the elements and build quality appears top notch.

My expectation is that with normal care, this grill will last the wife and I for decades.  I also have a small Weber Smokey Joe, so together I think I'll be able do almost all the types of outdoor cooking I want to enjoy.
Results.Title: Great Build Quality

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and clean. Great flavors from a small grill.
Results.Title: Weber keeps improving

Results.ReviewText: Amazing grill for quick dinner cooks and tailgating. Gets hot fast and cooks across grill evenly. My first propane grill. In just a few minutes dinner is done.
Results.Title: Great for quick meals

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill does the job perfectly.  Temperature gauge is a bonus.  Easy to put together.  Easily fits food for two people if grilling veg and meat but thrre is a lot of cooking surface for grilling meat for up to 6vpeople easily.  We bought the cart too and we are loving its big cook personality that os easily moved around on picnics too.  You wont regret this purchase.
Results.Title: The best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: My favorite grill! I’ve owned other grills and this is the best. So easy to assemble, cook and clean. I use the Weber Grate Grill Cleaner along with the Weber 12” Grill brush to clean the grill. I highly recommend the Q1200!
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill that gets extremely hot very fast and cooks evenly - this baby packs a punch and allows me to cook meals for up to 4 people. It is reliable, sturdy, and efficient, especially for our small apartment balcony. Game changer!
Results.Title: Game Changer

Results.ReviewText: Absolute perfection! The size is just right, the grates clean up beautifully, it's high quality, sturdy, and it's simple to move around. Assembly is nothing. I can't say enough great things about this grill. I put it in the garage after use and weather is never an issue for wear and tear. Don't hesitate to buy this as your every day grill. Unless you're cooking for a large crowd, this baby will fit enough for dinner for a family of 4- no problem. While I'm no longer in an apartment/big city, THIS IS THE GRILL for you city dwellers too. Thrilled.
Results.Title: Absolute Perfection!

Results.ReviewText: The quality of the q1200 is as good as any Weber grill I have owned.
Results.Title: Weber excellence!

ClientResponses.Response: Hello! We are sorry to hear this. We would encourage you to install the gas valve and regulator assembly that was recently sent. This part should not cause a leak to develop but if you do need additional assistance, please contact our support team. We will be happy to help. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
This is the 3rd Weber Grill in my life I have purchased. I have always been very satisfied until now.
Problem: the alignment of the connection between the grill and my 16oz tank is significantly off, causing a coughing of the outer edge of the tank. I see a long term problem of a possible leak down the connection line. I sent in a picture of this to Weber. They sent me the connection line. I feel if I change it, I will get a leak and ruin the grill. ie: $200 up in smoke. Will I purchase another of these grills, not sure. I think you have a design problem. Please respond!
Results.Title: Poor gas grill connection

Results.ReviewText: Bought older version 15 years ago best ting ever.Works good look good no rust like new. Best investment love it
Results.Title: Best grill

Results.ReviewText:
I never planned on owning a gas grill. This one is my first and I planned on using it for camping only. This is such a well made grill! I use it all the time. The high doomed lid is why I chose this one over other brands. Roasting is  great. I also purchased the skillet. We have used this for veggies and bacon so far. 
  I am so surprised with the functionality of the grill and it’s convenience. I have cooked some great meals on it and am currently teaching the wife how to cook on it. (I will not let her touch my bbq charcoal smoker). Great grill and would buy again.
Results.Title: Lil Gas Grill with Muscle

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned Q series grill for some time now and I love them. I’ve given one to my brother and Dad and every now and then we share pictures of our grilling. My brother has taken theirs out camping, they are super functional and versatile!
Results.Title: Great Versatile Grill On The Go!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Weber grill because I am older and could no longer lift the big gas tanks to be refilled on the bigger Weber grill.   When I first used it the smaller Weber grill, it was easy to operate and I am comfortable with using it.
Results.Title: Good for older people

Results.ReviewText: Light and easy to move around, yet grill itself is very sturdy.  Grill heats up fast and heat is dispensed evenly which makes for all pieces on the grill cooked properly.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 Gas Grill
